name: CIMD Lab
description: Teaches OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents both ways: real PingFederate as the authorization server (owner-run, no mock), and the lab's own teaching server with a tester that breaks the document in a dozen ways. PingFederate acting as a CIMD client is measured NOT SUPPORTED (2026-11-05, PF 13.1: its only OAuth-client role, the OIDC IdP connection, requires a registered client secret — no 'none' auth, no document fetch). The H2 2026 tab adds a local simulation of an MCP gateway that prefers CIMD client registration: Mock table and Live engine, every claim tagged, Ping release claim UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 5250, loopback only). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5250 only). Edit composeFile to this checkout's absolute path. No catalog row matches, so there is no catalogId. Direction 1 needs PF_BASE_URL (real PingFederate). Hosted copy on the SE cluster at mockUrl (not mock-only: direction 1 uses real PingFederate, owner exception 2026-10-28).
